title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents

Instead of reposting it as news, I'd frame it through Tencent Cloud scenario and focus on technical explainer + hands-on walkthrough. Would that make the discussion more useful for developers?

summary_cn: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representa：离散自回归建模，特别是通过下一个标记预测，已成为现代语言模型的基石。将这种范式扩展到视觉可以使视觉和语言模型汇聚到一个统一的框架上，从而促进共享的方法和基础设施。
